query: I want to buy my first electric vehicle. Which EV should I get?
atoms: perspective: First-time EV buyer prioritizing ease and reliability
perspective: Budget-conscious buyer maximizing tax credit value
plausible_answers: Answer A (Tesla Model 3 Default): Get a Tesla Model 3 — the Supercharger network, range, and overall ownership experience make it the most reliable first EV, and the premium over competitors is justified by the reduced anxiety of long-distance travel.

Answer B (Ioniq 6 for Range and Speed): Choose the Hyundai Ioniq 6 if range and charging speed are priorities — its 361-mile range and 800V ultra-fast charging rival Tesla at a lower price, with improving non-Tesla charging networks.

Answer C (Tax Credit Vehicle for Value): Buy a tax credit-eligible EV (Chevy Equinox EV, VW ID.4) — the $7,500 federal credit meaningfully reduces the effective purchase price and makes these vehicles better value than their sticker suggests.
baseline_answer: Answer A (Tesla Model 3 Default): Get a Tesla Model 3 — the Supercharger network, range, and overall ownership experience make it the most reliable first EV, and the premium over competitors is justified by the reduced anxiety of long-distance travel.
